name: Paste a Design (Level 0)
description: A one-section harness for bringing an existing React design — AI-generated or hand-built — into Uniweb with zero rewiring. Replace foundation/sections/App.jsx with your design and run: the home page is prewired and lucide-react (the icon set most AI tools emit) is preinstalled. SPA-first, so any design renders without server-side-rendering surprises. The starting point for the 'Converting Existing Designs' Level 0 workflow.
